name: All Terrain Vehicle
description: A self-propelled vehicle designed mainly to carry people or goods over unprepared surfaces, including a restricted use motorcycle (one built for off-highway use) and a mini-bike, but not one that must be registered under The Traffic Safety Act; an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria ridden off-road is one.

restrictions.rule: Designed mainly for unprepared surfaces, on wheels or tracks; no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: The All Terrain Vehicles Act, S.S. 1988-89, c. A-18.02, s. 2(1)(b)

restrictions.rule: A restricted use motorcycle isn't designed for highway use, has special features for off-highway use, and met the Canada Motor Vehicle Safety Standards for its type when built
restrictions.citation: The All Terrain Vehicles Act, S.S. 1988-89, c. A-18.02, s. 2(1)(s)

restrictions.rule: Operators need a driver's licence and must be 16 or older, except on land they or their immediate family own or occupy
restrictions.citation: The All Terrain Vehicles Act, S.S. 1988-89, c. A-18.02, ss. 3, 4 and 5(a)

restrictions.rule: From age 12 without a licence, on public or private land, crossing a highway or on its untravelled portion, if accompanied or supervised by someone licensed for at least a year, or after an approved training course
restrictions.citation: The All Terrain Vehicles Act, S.S. 1988-89, c. A-18.02, s. 5(b)

restrictions.rule: Kept off a highway's travelled portion except to cross it or use a bridge, or where the administrator or a municipal bylaw allows it; otherwise no closer than two metres to it
restrictions.citation: The All Terrain Vehicles Act, S.S. 1988-89, c. A-18.02, ss. 7 and 16(1)(d)

restrictions.rule: Needs liability insurance of at least $200,000 to be ridden on a highway or public land
restrictions.citation: The All Terrain Vehicles Act, S.S. 1988-89, c. A-18.02, s. 14; The All Terrain Vehicles Regulations, R.R.S. c. A-18.02 Reg 1, s. 4

restrictions.rule: Every operator and passenger must wear a strapped-on helmet designed for all terrain vehicles meeting AMA, ANSI, BSI, CSA, DOT, Snell or ECE standards, and eye protection, except on their own or their family's land
restrictions.citation: The All Terrain Vehicles Act, S.S. 1988-89, c. A-18.02, s. 18; The All Terrain Vehicles Regulations, R.R.S. c. A-18.02 Reg 1, ss. 5 and 6

restrictions.rule: No faster than 80 km/h, a passenger only if the manufacturer designed it to carry one, and prescribed lights at night
restrictions.citation: The All Terrain Vehicles Act, S.S. 1988-89, c. A-18.02, s. 16(1)(c), (g) and (h)

restrictions.rule: Needs permission from the owner or occupant of private land, and municipalities may ban it from roadsides, municipal land and private land in their limits
restrictions.citation: The All Terrain Vehicles Act, S.S. 1988-89, c. A-18.02, ss. 6 and 11
